[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies are acceptable for large lesions, including facial lesions such as lentigo maligna, acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "Consensus among experts on this recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 participants).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "The width of surgical margins should be determined by the thickness of the tumor.",
  "When indicated, sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and, whenever possible, in the same operative setting."
